verdict.rationale: Flagright documents configuring transaction monitoring rules. It offers rule templates (GET /rules), live rule instances that check transactions and can be created and idempotently updated via the Management API, and a no-code rule engine with nested logic. Nothing in the pack shows thresholds that vary by customer segment, so only the core rule-configuration half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: segment-specific threshold configuration, documented threshold parameters on rule instances, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds

citations.quote: `POST /rule-instances` endpoint is used to create a new rule instance. A rule instance can be thought of as a live entity, that runs checks for for transactions.
Created rule instances can be idempotently updated with the `POST /rule-instances/{ruleInstanceId}`.
Rule Engine - Build sophisticated rules using nested, no-code logic.
`GET /rules` endpoint returns a lot of all rule templates supported by flagright.
